long_biography.plain_text:
At Dancing Petrel, Kim Gilkison took on a vineyard whose vines had been allowed to decline. She and Graham Gilkison pruned the old plantings, added new vines and rebuilt production while changing careers from engineering ownership to Northland winegrowing. Their work earned recognition for sustainable methods and gave the estate a public tasting room.

Earlier, Kim had been a director and co-owner of ITL, a New Plymouth engineering services company that supplied oil-and-gas projects in New Zealand and abroad. LogiCamms acquired ITL in 2013. That business experience preceded Kim's move into viticulture, where she continues to host visitors and sell wine from the restored estate.
